I love this! It make blow drying so easy!

Love how smooth my hair looks. But it does get too hot real quick.

Bought for my teenage daughter to help style her chin length hair. I'm very impressed how well it worked. Her hair came out smooth with volume but not frizzy.  It didn't come with any clips or gloves as other products identical to this include though.  Edit: 2nd day, went to dry my hair and it wasn't getting hot like it did yesterday. Low and high were the same temperature. I pretty much dried my hair on the cool setting. 20 minutes into it and it finally got hot.

It’s described as having a COOL setting, NO it’s actually a Warm setting, at high Force Medium setting is Low force and Hot High setting is High force and Hot  The thin 1.5 “ brush has terribly scratchy rough bristles! Not good for hair or scalp The Big brush has tipped bristles and is oval shaped, looks like it would straighten hair.  The entire item is lightweight& easy to grasp. 1000 watts of dryer power.

This hot air brush has lots of power, but my hair is on the shorter side and even the smaller brush is too large. The smaller brush is also very scratchy, the tips need a new design or some type of coating to protect the scalp. I kept it because other products with smaller brushes do not have sufficient power to dry my hair.

Loved the way my hair looked after using. However, it gets extremely hot on the brush end. If you need to use two hands, then it’s too hot to hold. Worst part, it only lasted about 6 weeks and it quit. It wouldn’t work at all. So I would recommend not purchasing if that’s it’s life span.

You're not going to want to use this on out of the shower, wet hair. It will take forever and I only have chin length hair. I have to use my 1200 watt hair dryer to dry it, then use this for styling. For a 1000 watt styler, it is really sad as far as blowing. No power, but lots of heat.

claims.text: Users frequently praise how easy and quick the tool is to use, saying it cuts drying and styling time significantly.
Many reviewers report that it leaves hair smooth, straight, and with added volume, even on curly or thick hair.
Several reviewers note that the tool gets very hot quickly, sometimes hot enough to risk burning the scalp.
A few users mention issues with the brush design or handle, such as misaligned bristles or a thick, hard-to-grip handle.
Some reviewers question durability or report the product stopped working shortly after purchase.
